elements.--input-bg: Text boxes, drop-downs, table stripes and inset areas
elements.--heading: Headings and labels in the open tab
elements.--accent: Primary colour: main buttons, selected items, focus
elements.--accent-2: Highlight colour: links, hover, active markers (primary buttons blend --accent into it)
elements.--danger: Errors, delete actions and failure badges
elements.background: CSS background for the whole window (a colour or gradient)
elements.swatch: CSS background of the theme's sample in Configure → Theme
elements.scheme: "dark" or "light" (light themes put the logo on a dark badge)

themes.name: Dark Cyan
themes.background: radial-gradient(circle at 10% 20%, rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.2), transparent 35%), radial-gradient(circle at 90% 10%, rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.15), transparent 30%), #0a1628
